Description: Identifier assigned to a patient
Business_Use: Distinguish unique patients from hospital visit volume
Potential_Issues: Check for missing IDs, inconsistent formats and repeated patients across visits. Investigate whether repeated IDs represent legitimate separate encounters or duplicate records.

Description: Date of the hospital visit or admission
Business_Use: Analyse patient demand over time and validate derived date fields
Potential_Issues: Check for missing, invalid, future or inconsistently formatted dates.

Description: Patient age at the time of the visit
Business_Use: Segment patient demand and resource utilisation by age
Potential_Issues: Check for missing, negative, non-numeric or unrealistic ages.

Description: Recorded gender of the patient
Business_Use: Support demographic segmentation where relevant
Potential_Issues: Check for missing values, leading or trailing spaces, spelling differences, abbreviations and inconsistent capitalisation.

Description: Primary disease or condition associated with the visit
Business_Use: Analyse demand and resource use by condition
Potential_Issues: Check for missing values, inconsistent spelling, duplicate categories and leading or trailing spaces.

Description: Recorded severity level of the patient condition
Business_Use: Assess how condition severity relates to resource requirements
Potential_Issues: Check for missing values, unexpected categories, inconsistent spelling and capitalisation.

Description: Type of hospital admission or visit
Business_Use: Compare demand length of stay and resource utilisation by admission type
Potential_Issues: Check for missing values, invalid categories and inconsistent labels.

Description: Number of days the patient remained in hospital
Business_Use: Measure hospital stay burden across patient and operational groups
Potential_Issues: Check for missing, negative or unusually large values. Investigate zero-day stays in relation to admission type before treating them as invalid.

Description: Indicates whether the patient required a hospital bed
Business_Use: Measure demand for hospital beds
Potential_Issues: Check for missing values and inconsistent representations such as Yes, Y, 1 or TRUE.

Description: Indicates whether the patient required intensive care
Business_Use: Measure demand for intensive care resources
Potential_Issues: Check for missing values and inconsistent Yes or No representations.

Description: Indicates whether the patient required oxygen support
Business_Use: Measure demand for oxygen support
Potential_Issues: Check for missing values and inconsistent Yes or No representations.

Description: Indicates whether the patient required ventilator support
Business_Use: Measure demand for high-intensity respiratory support
Potential_Issues: Check for missing values and inconsistent Yes or No representations.

Description: Recorded number of hospital beds available
Business_Use: Support assessment of hospital bed capacity pressure
Potential_Issues: Check for missing, negative, zero or unrealistic values. Clarify whether values represent hospital-level capacity at the time of each visit and whether repeated values represent the same capacity snapshot.

Description: Recorded number of hospital beds occupied
Business_Use: Measure hospital bed utilisation
Potential_Issues: Check for missing or negative values and values greater than Total_Beds_Available. Clarify the reporting level of the measure.

Description: Recorded number of ICU beds available
Business_Use: Support assessment of ICU capacity pressure
Potential_Issues: Check for missing, negative or unrealistic values. Clarify whether values represent hospital-level capacity at the time of each visit.

Description: Recorded number of ICU beds occupied
Business_Use: Measure ICU bed utilisation
Potential_Issues: Check for missing or negative values and values greater than ICU_Beds_Available. Clarify the reporting level of the measure.

Description: Recorded quantity of oxygen units used
Business_Use: Measure oxygen resource utilisation
Potential_Issues: Check for missing, negative or unusually high values. Clarify the unit of measurement and whether this represents patient-level, visit-level or reporting-period usage.

Description: Numeric month associated with the visit date
Business_Use: Analyse monthly demand patterns
Potential_Issues: Check for missing values, numbers outside 1 to 12 and disagreement with Visit_Date.

Description: Season associated with the visit
Business_Use: Analyse broader seasonal demand patterns
Potential_Issues: Check for missing values, unexpected categories and spelling differences. Confirm how season categories are defined and whether they match the source dataset's geographical context.

Description: Day of the week associated with the visit
Business_Use: Analyse day-of-week demand patterns
Potential_Issues: Check for missing values, spelling differences and disagreement with Visit_Date.

Description: Hospital department responsible for the visit
Business_Use: Identify where patient demand and resource pressure are concentrated
Potential_Issues: Check for missing values, inconsistent spelling, abbreviations and leading or trailing spaces.

Description: Indicates whether the patient was recorded as readmitted within 30 days
Business_Use: Analyse repeat hospital utilisation
Potential_Issues: Check for missing values and inconsistent Yes or No representations. Where possible compare the field with repeated Patient_ID values and Visit_Date intervals.
